# EduNode

> EduNode is an educational platform for becoming a blockchain developer. It offers interactive courses, coding challenges, verifiable certificates, and community resources focused on Stellar, Web3, Soroban, Ethereum, Hyperledger, and related decentralized technologies.

## Courses

- [All Courses](https://edunode.org/courses): Index of all blockchain and Web3 courses
- [Basic Concepts](https://edunode.org/courses/101): Blockchain and Stellar fundamentals
- [Operations](https://edunode.org/courses/102): Stellar network operations
- [Anchors](https://edunode.org/courses/103): Stellar anchors and fiat on/off ramps
- [SEPs](https://edunode.org/courses/104): Stellar Ecosystem Proposals
- [Hyperledger](https://edunode.org/courses/105): Enterprise blockchain with Hyperledger
- [Soroban](https://edunode.org/courses/106): Smart contracts on Stellar
- [Ethereum Basics](https://edunode.org/courses/107): Introduction to Ethereum
- [Oracles Basics](https://edunode.org/courses/108): Blockchain oracles fundamentals
- [System Engineering](https://edunode.org/courses/109): System engineering concepts
- [Blockchain y Web3](https://edunode.org/courses/110): Blockchain and Web3 course (Spanish)
- [Mujeres en Web3](https://edunode.org/courses/111): Women in Web3 (Spanish)

## Tools

- [Code Playground](https://edunode.org/codeeditor): In-browser code editor — JavaScript runs locally, Rust and Solidity for drafting smart contracts
- [ChainChess](https://edunode.org/chess): A working chess game where every move teaches a Web3/blockchain concept
- [Stellar Nodes Map](https://edunode.org/stellarnodes): Interactive map of Stellar network nodes
- [Certificate Verification](https://edunode.org/validCertificate): Verify EduNode certificates
- [Glossary](https://edunode.org/glossary): Popular Web3 and blockchain terms explained
